title.sr: Obrada porudžbine od prijema do isporuke (telefon)
title.en: Handling an order from receipt to delivery (phone)

intro.sr: Administrator vodi porudžbinu kroz statuse: u obradi, poslato, dostavljeno, završeno. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: An administrator takes an order through the statuses: processing, shipped, delivered, completed. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
